name: Essence Overwhelming (First The Ebon Dragon Excellency)

system.description: The Green Sun Prince can invoke this Charm when making any roll based on the Ebon Dragon's nature. This Charm adds one die to the roll for each mote spent, to a maximum of (Attribute + Ability) dice. Characters can also use this Charm to enhance static values: roll one die per mote spent, with each success increasing the effective (Attribute + Ability) by two and raising an applicable DV by one. Compatible with the Second Excellency; incompatible with the Third Excellency.
